_note: Single-source (Classical Greek, Athens/Sparta). Hellenic sub-palette of the Classical family; polis city-states. Even alignment split across all three. Seed names are Hellenic-flavored coinages, not historical figures.

phonology.palette: Hellenic: a e i o u + long e/o; aspirates th/ph/kh; endings -os/-on/-es/-eus/-e; s, l, r, n.
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; clusters kt/pt/st/ph/th/kh/ps; -os/-on common; vowel-final frequent.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic suffix -ides / -ades (son of); plus deme/polis demonym of origin.
morphology.compounding_rule: [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with linking -o-: melas + oros -> Melanoros; or Nea + Polis -> Neapolis.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenic feudal monarchy; polis/republican forms are aesthetic flavor, not modeled)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Hellenic, ascending (barony, march, county, duchy, principality, kingdom, empire). -arch/-archy rhyme the lower tiers; Basileus/Basileia and Autokrator/Autokratoria the high. The march renders as a garrison command (Phrourarch).
title_ladder._government_note: Polis/republican institutions (Boule, Ekklesia) are narrative flavor only; mechanically Achillea is a feudal realm.

people_name_convention.order: personal + patronymic (-ides) + polis/deme demonym; often just personal + patronymic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: citizens use personal + patronymic + deme; the renowned earn a descriptive epithet (ho Megas).
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the morphed deity-names (e.g. Tulrio-, Numeno-, Orlandro-).

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Hellenic phonology (-os/-on/-es; th/ph/kh) — recognizably the same powers, never real Greek gods.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; the One, unknowable source, honored not petitioned)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power keeps its morphed name + a portfolio epithet (the suffix -daimon may mark a demon), distinct per power: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame; Dementus -> Dementhos the Mad; Desoria -> Desorios the Drowner.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Mysteria/Temenos of [power]: 'the Mysteries of Numenos'.
religion.saints_pattern: Heros [name] (deified hero/founder), venerated at a heroon (tomb-shrine).

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: radiate sun above olive-branch and scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandros: iron spear crossed with an oath-ring

banks_patterns.ships: feminine -is, virtue & sea names: 'Nike', 'Thalassa', 'Pride of Achillea'
